# Copper Scroll Column 12 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

This log records all lines in Copper Scroll Column 12 (treasure locations 59-64; conclusion) where the three translators diverged, along with SOPHIA's resolution.

---

## 12:1 — near/by Beth Ha-kos

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "near Beth Ha-kos" |
| LOGOS | "near Beth Ha-kos" |
| PNEUMA | "by Beth Ha-kos" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "near Beth Ha-kos" per EMET/LOGOS consensus.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/LOGOS.

---

## 12:6 — with four sides to its entrance / its entrance having four sides / four-sided entrance

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "with four sides to its entrance" |
| LOGOS | "its entrance having four sides" |
| PNEUMA | "through its four-sided entrance" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET's "with four sides to its entrance" as the most literal rendering of the Hebrew spatial description.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 12:10 — one jar of silver / a single jar / a silver jar

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "one jar of silver" — literal kad echad shel kesef |
| LOGOS | "a single jar of silver" — formal |
| PNEUMA | "a silver jar" — simplified (loses echad) |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET's "one jar of silver" preserving the numeral echad and the Hebrew word order.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 12:14 — outlet of the Periyah phrasing

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "at the outlet of the Peri[yah]" — literal motsa' |
| LOGOS | "at the outlet of the Peri[yah]" — same |
| PNEUMA | "where the Peri[yah] flows out" — dynamic |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "at the outlet of the Peri[yah]" per EMET/LOGOS. PNEUMA's verbal paraphrase loses the nominal form.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/LOGOS.

---

## 12:15 — consecrated offering / sacred offering devoted to God

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "all that is in it is consecrated offering" |
| LOGOS | "all its contents are consecrated offering" |
| PNEUMA | "everything inside is sacred offering, devoted to God" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET's "all that is in it is consecrated offering." PNEUMA's "devoted to God" adds theological interpretation. "Consecrated" captures herem without elaboration.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 12:16-17 — duplicate/second copy + interpretation/key + location phrasing

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "A duplicate of this document and its interpretation are at a distance of [...]" |
| LOGOS | "A duplicate of this document, with its interpretation, lies at a distance of [...]" |
| PNEUMA | "A second copy of this scroll, with its key, is hidden at a distance of [...]" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS's rendering "A duplicate of this document, with its interpretation" — "with" better connects the items. PNEUMA's "key" for pesher and "hidden" are interpretive. "Document" preferred over "scroll" since the original is inscribed on copper, not a scroll.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

*Total disagreements in Column 12: 6*
